actual: Auto-filed CI/Nightly infrastructure issues can still include a generic promote-ci-issue handoff even when triage-ci-issue classifies the failure as infra_blocker/infra_flaky and needs_bug_json=false. This can send Codex/Claude windows into an unnecessary code BUG promotion/fix loop instead of the infra action path, wasting time and tokens. Expected: infra-only CI/Nightly issues should keep triage as the first command, clearly mark needs_bug_json=false, and either omit promote/fix-after-promotion commands or mark them as not applicable; real regression issues should keep the normal promote -> run flow.
closure_requirements: Keep BUG JSON and GitHub Issue synchronized.
